# Privacy Policy for Floatkit

**Effective Date:** May 2026

Thank you for choosing to use Floatkit. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy.

## 1. Information We Collect

**Floatkit prioritizes your privacy by keeping your personal data local.** We do not collect, transmit, track, or store your personal data on any external servers. All data generated by your use of the app (such as notes, tasks, and voice memos) is stored exclusively on your device's internal storage. While the app includes an inline web search feature that requires internet access to fetch results from search engines, your local files and private app data are never uploaded or shared.

The app requests the following permissions strictly to provide its core features:

*   **Display Over Other Apps (Overlay):** Required to display the floating sidebar dock over your other active applications.
*   **All Files Access (MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE):** Required for our core feature, Global Search. This broad permission allows the app to index and search all file types on your device (including documents, PDFs, and archives), not just media. All scanning, indexing, and processing is performed entirely offline on your device. We do not access your files for any other purpose, and no files or metadata are ever transmitted off your device.
*   **Microphone (Record Audio):** Required to record voice memos within the app. Audio files are saved directly to your device's local storage.
*   **Notifications:** Required to run the foreground background service that keeps the floating sidebar active and allows you to easily control the app's visibility.
*   **Query All Packages (Package Visibility):** Required for the App Launcher feature to detect and display your installed applications for quick launching.
*   **Modify System Settings:** Required for the Tools Panel to adjust your device's display brightness. This permission is used locally and no settings data is transmitted externally.
*   **Accessibility Service (Optional):** May be requested for advanced system interactions such as the Power Menu. This service is used solely for local system control and does not collect or transmit any accessibility data.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

Since we do not collect or transmit any data off your device, we do not process your information externally. Your notes, tasks, saved clipboard items, voice memos, screenshots, pinned applications, and settings are exclusively read and written locally on your device to provide you with the Floatkit experience.

The App Launcher feature reads your installed application list locally to enable quick app launching and pinning to the sidebar. The Tools Panel adjusts your device's volume and brightness settings locally using Android system APIs. No system settings data is transmitted or stored externally.

The Backup & Restore feature allows you to export your data into a compressed archive (.zip) for safekeeping. This feature relies entirely on the Android Storage Access Framework (SAF) to write this backup archive directly to the local or cloud-backed directory of your choosing. We do not transmit, sync, or upload your backup files to any developer-owned servers. Once exported, the security and privacy of the backup file are your sole responsibility.

## 3. Third-Party Services (Google Play)

While Floatkit is primarily an offline application and does not collect personal data on our servers, we utilize Google Play services to manage premium features and updates:
*   **Google Play Billing:** Used to securely process your in-app purchases and subscriptions.
*   **Google Play Core:** Used to check for and deliver in-app updates.
*   **License Verification:** Used to verify the integrity and legitimate purchase status of the app.

When you interact with these features, Google Play may collect and process information such as your device information, network connection, and payment history in accordance with the Google Privacy Policy. We do not have access to your payment details or credit card information.

## 4. Data Sharing

We do not share, sell, rent, or trade any of your information with third parties. Your data remains strictly on your own device.

## 5. Data Retention and Security

The security of your data is governed by your Android device's built-in security features (e.g., lock screen, disk encryption). We also utilize EncryptedSharedPreferences to securely store your premium status.

You have full control over your data. If you use the "Clear All Data" feature in the Floatkit Settings menu, all locally stored database entries (Notes, Tasks, Clipboard) and recorded audio files associated with Floatkit will be permanently deleted. Uninstalling the app will also wipe this data.

## 6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by updating the "Effective Date" at the top of this document.
